description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/sales_data.xlsx. The sheet contains sales data in cells B2:E6. In cell B8, create a SUM formula to calculate total of all sales: =SUM(B2:E6). In cell B9, create an AVERAGE formula: =AVERAGE(B2:E6). In cell B10, create a MAX formula: =MAX(B2:E6). Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
